title: U-M shrinks pay for Dearborn, Flint chancellors as it doubles it in Ann Arbor
summary_en: U-M has steadily increased the salary for the president of its flagship school, but new chancellors coming in to lead regional campuses make less than predecessors, records show.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: U-M shrinks pay for Dearborn, Flint chancellors as it doubles it in Ann Arbor

title: Michigan schools sweat as deadline looms without state budget: It’s ‘super frustrating’
summary_en: Michigan House, Senate cancel session with just days before legal deadline to pass state budget. ‘We were hopeful,’ said a spokesperson for Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
author: Jordyn Hermani
title_cn: Michigan schools sweat as deadline looms without state budget: It’s ‘super frustrating’

title: Michigan must focus literacy efforts on older students, too, experts say
summary_en: Many raise concerns with Michigan’s reading scores. Elementary school kids are often the focus. But what about older students who still struggle to read?
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Michigan must focus literacy efforts on older students, too, experts say
